dataRoles.name: columns
dataRoles.description: Columns and Measures to display in the table

headerLabels.description: JSON {"ColumnName":"Label"}. Can be plugged into a DAX measurement via the FX button.

orderJson.description: JSON array of column names in the order that the array requires. Ex: ["Col1","Col2"]. Columns not mentioned are added at the end. Can be plugged into a DAX measurement via the FX button.

hiddenColumns.displayName: Hidden columns in the grid (JSON / fx)
hiddenColumns.description: A JSON array of column names to hide in the grid. Ex: ["Col1","Col2"]. These columns remain in the Columns role (so available for filtering/modaling) but are not displayed in the table. Can be plugged into a DAX measurement via the fx button.

columnFormats.description: JSON format definition per column. Ex: {"Col1":{"type":"date","format":"dd/MM/yyyy"},"Col2":{"type":"number","decimals":2,"minWidth":110},"Col3":{"type":"boolean","trueLabel":"✓","falseLabel":"✗"}}. Can be plugged into a DAX measurement via the fx button.

defaultSortJson.description: JSON array of sort specs applied when no manual sort is active. Ex: [{"column":"Col1","dir":"DESC"},{"column":"Col2","dir":"ASC"}]. Clicking a header overrides it. Can be plugged into a DAX measure via the fx button.

titleText.description: Detail window title text. Can be plugged into a DAX measurement via the fx button. If empty, the title takes the value of the first visible column of the clicked row.

debugMode.description: Temporary diagnostic aid: shows requested vs. actually measured dialog dimensions at the top of the modal. Disable once the sizing issue is resolved.

layoutJson.description: Mandatory positional layout of the modal fields. JSON array of three entry types: (1) fields — {"field":"Col1","labelField":"Label_Col1","label":"Fallback label","row":1,"col":1,"colspan":2,"rowspan":1}; "labelField" references a column/measure (e.g. dropped in Hidden columns) whose per-row VALUE is used as the label — the recommended way to handle multilingual labels via DAX (_langue_active pattern), resolved before the static "label" and before headerLabels. (2) dividers — {"type":"divider","row":4,"label":"Section title"}; reserves its whole row (no field/list may share it) and renders a full-width rule with an optional section label, using the existing accent color. (3) lists — {"type":"list","row":7,"delimiter":";","columns":[{"field":"NamesMeasure","labelField":"LBL_NAME"},{"field":"TypesMeasure","labelField":"LBL_TYPE"}]}; for one-to-many data (e.g. multiple owners) — each referenced field/measure must return a delimited string (typical CONCATENATEX/FILTER convention); the visual splits every column by "delimiter" (default ";") and renders an aligned mini-table (header row + one row per item, missing items shown as "—"). Reserves its whole row like a divider. Only listed fields are displayed (no auto-fallback). Fields may reference any column of the Columns role, including ones hidden in the grid. Empty/default ("[]") shows a neutral placeholder; invalid JSON shows an explicit error panel in the modal. Can be plugged into a DAX measurement via the fx button.

modalFieldFormats.description: JSON format specific to the modal fields, independent of the grid format. Ex: {"Col1":{"type":"date","format":"dd MMMM yyyy"}}. Can be plugged into a DAX measurement via the fx button.

filterKey.description: The name of the column in the table whose value serves as the click filter key. Can be hidden in the grid.

targetTable.description: The exact name of the Power BI table to filter

targetColumn.description: The name of the column in the target table on which to apply the Basic filter.

rowFilterJson.description: Display-only filter: rows matching the rules are removed from the grid, sorting and pagination — no filter is sent to the model. JSON array, rules combined with AND. Ex: [{"column":"Status","mode":"exclude","values":["Deleted","Cancelled"]}]. "mode" is "exclude" (default) or "include". The column may be hidden in the grid. Can be plugged into a DAX measure via the fx button.
